title: Capture exact installed artifacts
exercise: Record core, frontend, kit, app UI, editor versions; capture actual routes with synthetic fixtures and ordinary roles.
expected: Source pins are not mislabeled deployed versions; each image records environment and state.

title: Measure root and component geometry
exercise: Measure computed sizes on representative legacy and new controls at default and changed user text size.
expected: Token dimensions match the approved scale; density changes do not create accidental tiny labels or clipped controls.

title: Meaningful text contrast
exercise: Measure all meaningful labels on actual normal, selected, hover and disabled-policy backgrounds.
expected: Applicable contrast targets pass; decorative/disabled exceptions are documented rather than applied to useful metadata.

title: User accents and dark mode
exercise: Apply adversarial bright/dark accents, system theme switching and high contrast.
expected: Text, controls, focus and chart roles remain distinguishable; stored preferences are retained.

title: Semantic status mapping
exercise: Render positive, negative, unknown and translated domain states.
expected: Tone follows stable state IDs; Not approved is not classified by substring; text/icon remains available.

title: Font failure and scripts
exercise: Block primary font downloads and test English, Arabic, Hindi and mixed-script content.
expected: Content remains usable with fallback; marks, numerals and controls are not clipped; no external font dependency is required for offline use.

title: Rem-scale migration
exercise: Enable candidate typography across all dependent reference apps and embedded frames.
expected: No unexpected geometry explosion; intentional changes are reviewed; authored documents are not restyled.

title: Button semantic compatibility
exercise: Exercise legacy/default/primary/destructive/loading variants through adapters.
expected: Action emphasis and disabled/loading meaning are preserved; labels remain stable while busy.

title: Overlay focus
exercise: Open nested menu/dialog/popover from keyboard and pointer, then dismiss or submit.
expected: Focus is trapped only where appropriate, Escape semantics are clear, and focus returns to the initiating control.

title: Toolbar keyboard model
exercise: Navigate editor controls using keyboard without tabbing through unrelated UI repeatedly.
expected: Selection remains valid; roving focus and embedded input behavior follow the documented toolbar contract.

title: Touch hit areas
exercise: Test coarse-pointer controls, dense lists and adjacent icon actions.
expected: Product touch targets and required spacing are met without invisible overlapping hit zones.

title: Navigation hierarchy
exercise: Complete a cross-app task and return using browser history.
expected: Tenant/app/location are unambiguous; no redundant chrome; prior selection and task context survive.

title: Restricted and empty navigation
exercise: Use ordinary, portal, read-only and newly deprovisioned roles.
expected: Only appropriate navigation is presented; refusal is not disguised as empty business data; server policy remains authoritative.

title: Narrow and short viewport
exercise: Resize to small width, short height, large text and embedded panel sizes.
expected: No fixed-height assumption hides primary actions; ordinary forms reflow; complex canvases provide supported navigation.

title: Loading and stale state
exercise: Delay route and data loads independently, then fail them.
expected: No blank meaningful route; skeleton matches composition; existing data is visibly stale rather than fabricated current data.

title: Triage and reading
exercise: Process a realistically populated inbox with keyboard and pointer.
expected: Sender/subject/preview/time hierarchy is scannable; selected, unread and focus states remain distinct.

title: Pane resize
exercise: Resize mailbox/list/reading panes across laptop and tablet sizes.
expected: Minima preserve usability; mode changes before content becomes unusable; preferences are scoped and clamped.

title: Draft preservation
exercise: Edit recipients, body and attachments; navigate, reload and interrupt synchronization.
expected: Draft survives according to declared durability; unsent and unsynchronized states are accurately labeled.

title: Send ambiguity
exercise: Lose the response after mail submission and retry through supported recovery.
expected: No false delivery claim; no unsupported duplicate send; user sees a recoverable or unresolved state.

title: Shortcut/input coexistence
exercise: Type letters used as shortcuts in search, compose, IME and dialogs.
expected: Typing never triggers destructive actions; navigation shortcuts remain discoverable outside inputs.

title: Untrusted email
exercise: Open hostile HTML, blocked remote images and suspicious attachments.
expected: Sanitization/isolation stay intact; safe content remains readable; labels do not falsely certify the sender.

title: Mobile compose
exercise: Compose/reply with virtual keyboard, long recipients and attachment errors.
expected: Primary controls remain reachable; text is readable; no accidental context loss.

title: Find and preview
exercise: Find a file by scoped search, sort and filter; preview then return.
expected: Query, selection and scroll are retained; metadata communicates location and sharing.

title: Bulk selection
exercise: Select across pages and apply an allowed operation with mixed item permissions.
expected: The selected scope is explicit; per-item failures are visible; successful work is not falsely undone.

title: Upload failure
exercise: Upload a folder containing duplicates, oversized and rejected files, then interrupt connection.
expected: Progress distinguishes transferring/processing/available; recovery preserves eligible work and explains exclusions.

title: Sharing lifecycle
exercise: Create, revoke and expire a share; change owner/access while a dialog remains open.
expected: Effective audience and expiry are visible; current server authority governs completion.

title: Long content
exercise: Render long names, mixed scripts, missing thumbnails and large folders.
expected: Important extensions/actions remain reachable; no misleading previews or silent truncation of critical identity.

title: Writing focus
exercise: Write and format a long document with outline and comments toggled.
expected: Document is dominant; toolbar does not steal selection; line length and typography match the approved view.

title: Collaborative change
exercise: Edit from two users, anchor comments, suggest edits and change permissions.
expected: Existing collaboration and native permission semantics survive; cursors/comments remain meaningful.

title: Offline/save boundary
exercise: Disconnect during edits and attempt tab close, recovery and reconnect.
expected: Browser-only state is not called server-saved; unsaved data has a supported recovery path.

title: IME and undo
exercise: Use composed-script input, paste, multiple formatting operations and undo/redo.
expected: No shortcut interference, lost composition or unexpected undo jumps caused by new toolbar state.

title: Document formatting contract
exercise: Import documents with explicit fonts/styles and export after UI theme changes.
expected: UI typography/theme does not silently modify authored formatting or export semantics.

title: Engine and file readiness
exercise: Launch supported, unavailable and unsupported-file sessions.
expected: Engine-ready is not confused with file-ready; failure has a recovery/open-with path.

title: External appearance bridge
exercise: Change theme, locale and host size using each supported editor adapter.
expected: Only supported settings are sent; no DOM/security bypass; unsupported customization is disclosed.

title: Grid workflow
exercise: Edit formulas/ranges, freeze panes, use protected cells and keyboard navigation.
expected: Correct selection, numeric precision and workbook behavior are retained; spreadsheet is not replaced by a generic table.

title: Large and complex workbook
exercise: Open the agreed large-file and formula/fidelity corpus.
expected: Performance is measured; unsupported features are disclosed; progress/cancellation and save states are truthful.

title: Object workflow
exercise: Edit text/objects, reorder slides, present and export.
expected: Selection/properties/zoom remain coherent; keyboard equivalents and export fidelity are checked.

title: Form and annotation
exercise: Search, annotate, fill a supported form and save/export.
expected: Document appearance is preserved; no false saved state; restrictions and unsupported actions are clear.

title: Validation and conflict
exercise: Edit a consequential record, trigger several validation errors and a version conflict.
expected: Input is preserved; errors are associated; correction/rebase does not bypass business checks.

title: Financial values
exercise: Display large, negative, multi-currency and fractional values and totals.
expected: Alignment is clear and rounding is intentional; stored precision and business semantics do not change.

title: Destructive operation
exercise: Attempt cancellation/delete/refund under valid and revoked authority.
expected: Confirmation identifies scope and reversibility; pending/unresolved is not displayed as completed.

title: Scope clarity
exercise: Change an access policy while another role is reviewing the same data.
expected: Requested versus effective state is clear; hierarchy does not disguise permissions; audit remains available.

title: Accessible graph editing
exercise: Build and inspect a branching process using canvas and keyboard/outline.
expected: Essential functions work without dragging; invalid ports and source-only constructs are explicit.

title: Draft versus deployment
exercise: Save a draft, simulate it, review changes, and activate a permitted release.
expected: Draft/simulation/production are distinguishable; autosave does not imply deployment.

title: Data semantics
exercise: Render absent, zero, stale, partial and denied metric results.
expected: No invented trend/number; unit, period, scope, freshness and drill-down are explicit.

title: Proposed versus executed
exercise: Render advice, proposed action, approval, running action and uncertain result.
expected: Model prose never substitutes for authoritative operation state; evidence and material effect preview are visible.

title: Keyboard only
exercise: Complete reference journeys without pointer input.
expected: All actions reachable, focus visible, dialogs return focus, no keyboard trap.

title: Assistive technology
exercise: Complete representative tasks with a human screen-reader user.
expected: Control names, state changes, grids/toolbars and errors are understandable; issues are recorded.

title: Zoom and reflow
exercise: Test 200% text/zoom and required narrow reflow conditions.
expected: Ordinary task content remains usable; justified two-dimensional exceptions retain navigation alternatives.

title: Reduced and forced display modes
exercise: Enable reduced motion and forced/high contrast.
expected: Meaning and focus survive; no unnecessary motion remains; selected/error states do not depend only on color.

title: RTL complete journey
exercise: Complete Mail, Drive, record edit and editor-host navigation in Arabic.
expected: Logical layout, menus, focus and content direction are intentional; Latin identifiers/numbers are not corrupted.

title: Text expansion
exercise: Use long translated strings, varied date/currency formats and bidi names.
expected: Labels remain understandable; key actions do not disappear; formatting is consistent.

title: Realistic frontend interaction
exercise: Measure representative data sets on declared ordinary hardware/network.
expected: Typing, selection and scrolling remain responsive; bundle/load budgets are recorded, not invented.

title: Background activity
exercise: Receive updates while scrolling, editing and reviewing a panel.
expected: No layout jump, lost input or focus caused by refresh; heavy work remains bounded.

title: Mixed artifact versions
exercise: Load the declared supported combination of old/new shell, kit and app UI artifacts.
expected: Compatibility is proven or incompatible artifacts are refused; no duplicate shortcut handlers.

title: Preference migration
exercise: Upgrade and roll back layout while preserving density, panes, filters and drafts.
expected: Personal state migrates or resets with explanation; business/draft data is not lost.

title: Visual regression review
exercise: Run deterministic screenshots for reference states and review changes.
expected: Differences are approved by design/engineering; baselines are not auto-updated to hide defects.

title: Independent task evaluation
exercise: Ask representative staff to complete reference tasks without author guidance.
expected: Errors, time, comprehension and perceived quality are compared to the baseline; failed tasks are not masked by cosmetic scores.
